svg.title: How EternalMonitor works
svg.desc: The Windows PC captures the desktop, encodes the video on the GPU and sends it over Wi-Fi or USB. The iPad reassembles the video, asking for missing fragments on Wi-Fi, decodes it with VideoToolbox and shows it with Metal. PC audio is captured with WASAPI, encoded as Opus and played on the iPad. Touch, Pencil, keyboard and trackpad input travels back to the PC, which injects it.
